title: Deshaun Watson wants a home run after Jimmy Haslam called his signing a "swing and miss"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Deshaun Watson wants a home run after Jimmy Haslam called his signing a "swing and miss"
sources.description: Jimmy Haslam gave up on Deshaun Watson 15 months ago when the Browns owner called the team's signing of the quarterback "a big swing and miss."
